storyCards.headline: Oh Sherrie: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Steve Perry's "Oh Sherrie" reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Oh Sherrie" is the debut solo single by American singer Steve Perry.

Written by Perry, Randy Goodrum, Craig Krampf and Bill Cuomo, the song was recorded and released on Perry's first solo album Street Talk in 1984, which he released while still a member of Journey.

The track is composed in the key of F major with a time signature of 44, following a tempo of 120 beats per minute.

The song peaked at #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.
